message.content:
This editorial illustration for Tempo magazine is vertically oriented, featuring a red and white monochromatic color scheme. Three human faces of varying sizes are layered on top of each other, all facing forward. The largest face is in the upper right, partially obscured and translucent, with only the eyes and nose clearly visible. Below and to the left is a medium-sized face, showing a full head and shoulders. At the bottom left is the smallest face, also showing head and shoulders in a lighter, almost white shade. All figures have neutral expressions.

The background is a solid, vibrant red. Large black text "TEMPO" is at the top center. Above it, "EDISI KHUSUS KEMERDEKAAN" is written in white. Below "TEMPO" is "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU" in small black letters. To the left, a large white "74TH" is visible. Names "Djiauw Kie Siong, Yap Tjwan Bing, Liem Koen Hian" appear in small white text on the left. On the right, large white text reads "Aktivis Cina di Awal Republik." Below this, smaller white text describes the role of "Etnis Tionghoa" in the "revolusi Indonesia." At the bottom right, there is a date "19-25 AGUSTUS 2019," a price, a website, and a barcode.
